caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular quilt with a patterned design rendered in colors including green, red, pink, and white. The quilt features a grid of evenly spaced starburst or floral motifs arranged in rows and columns, primarily colored in green and red with accents of pink. Each motif is enclosed in a square with interconnecting red diamond shapes forming a lattice throughout the quilt. The interior section of the quilt is framed with a red saw-tooth border, followed by a wider outer border that has a repeating green triangle pattern on a white background. The area between the inner and outer borders contains a light wavy-line design. The quilt's overall background color is white or off-white. The drawing is bordered by a thin red outline, and a signature is visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
